title: USED KIT NO LONGER CUTS HAZARD PAY
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. Hazard pay, the XP for the haul, haul contracts and your best haul all count what you bring out less what you carried up. Kit you carried up and then used, dropped or gave away still counted as carried up, so two Medkits used in a fight cut $420 off the haul: $2,000 found on +35% Terms paid $553 instead of $700, and the loaner Bandages did the same to a new player every run. Now only carried kit still in your backpack at the end is taken off, and lifetime earnings are unchanged.
now: Kit you carry up and then use, drop or give away no longer cuts hazard pay or the haul.
